description: Parses a raw email header block and returns the delivery path (Received chain with per-hop timing), the SPF/DKIM/DMARC results the receiver recorded, the key envelope fields, and a From-vs-Return-Path domain alignment flag. Useful for spotting spoofed mail and diagnosing delivery delays.

headers.description: The raw email header block, e.g. from Gmail "Show original" or Outlook "Internet headers". Include the full block from the top down to the blank line before the body.

name: analyze_email_headers
title: Analyze email headers
